diagnostic_pair.purpose: measure the six settlement interactions without Binance BBO fields

primary_pair.purpose: test incremental settlement-state value after the frozen BBO overlay

experiment.tree_candidate_change: none; the test is deliberately limited to whether explicit interactions repair the linear residual candidate
experiment.view_selection: the primary pair controls promotion; the diagnostic pair is reported and cannot promote alone

feature_contract.storage: deterministic hash-bound overlay only; no raw or base feature duplication

transform_definitions.twap_current_side: -1 for negative log margin, 0 for an exact tie, and 1 for positive log margin

hypothesis.alternative: Explicit causal interactions between exact observed TWAP60 margin, time remaining, realized TWAP variance, and path efficiency improve calibrated settlement probability and after-cost value beyond the same market-prior residual without those transforms.
hypothesis.contract_gap: The Round 27 design named distance-to-strike interacted with time remaining, but the frozen 182-field corpus stores margin and remaining time only as separate inputs. A linear residual cannot express that interaction without explicit transforms.
hypothesis.null: The six transforms add no matched out-of-sample probability or after-cost value after the executable Polymarket prior and the Round 28 Binance BBO overlay.
hypothesis.prior: Strong null. Public high-frequency studies report forecast discrimination or quote response without corresponding executable after-cost edge.

promotion_gates.accuracy: Condition-weighted accuracy and balanced accuracy are reported; neither can promote alone.
promotion_gates.economic: The primary augmented arm must improve source-bound after-cost net PnL and preserve every Round 27 execution, delay, concentration, drawdown, and confidence gate.
promotion_gates.minimum_population: Every inherited Round 27 role and economic population minimum remains unchanged.
promotion_gates.probability: The primary augmented arm must improve condition-weighted log loss and Brier score, with paired condition-bootstrap 95 percent upper bounds below zero.
promotion_gates.robustness: Report calibration, ROC-AUC, accepted coverage, source age, latency, and volatility/time-to-close strata; positive point estimates without statistical and economic gates are rejected.
promotion_gates.sealed: No sealed access unless one persisted primary pair passes all selection probability and economic gates.

research_basis.finding: Polymarket documents the feed as a Chainlink-computed 60-second lookback TWAP and requires exact fixed-point values and observation-time freshness.
Polymarket states that the custom feed sampling boundaries, weighting, rounding, and missing-input behavior are not public and warns against independent reproduction.
OpenMarket reports a measurable Polymarket response to large Binance moves but a null out-of-sample model and negative simulated economics after stated costs.
Deep order-book forecasting research warns that predictive metrics do not necessarily imply actionable transactions.

A recent five-minute Polymarket study reports that the currently leading side had high direction accuracy but explicitly lacks executable books, spreads, and cost evidence; current-side state is therefore only a candidate feature.
